**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Moor](../persons.html#1046)
Mr Reynolds has just been here about [Annie Norgate](../persons.html#917).[^1] I shall be most thankful to you for helping her, and shall gladly join in the £10.10 subscription for her

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Mr Davies writes to[^2]

[^1]: Anne Norgate (1876-1896), was blind.

Her death was registered in the last quarter of 1896.

[^2]: The letter breaks off thus.
